name: Italian Egg Muffins with Prosciutto, Roasted Red Peppers & Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F) and position a rack in the lower third of the oven. Grease 12 muffin cups with butter; place muffin pan on a baking sheet pan (to catch any overflow during baking) and set aside.
Roughly chop prosciutto into small pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Pat roasted peppers dry with paper towels, then roughly chop into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the prosciutto, along with the cheese, and stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Divide filling between muffin cups and set aside. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Crack eggs into the reserved bowl. Add Italian seasoning and pepper, then whisk to combine. Pour eggs over the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place muffin pan in the oven and bake, rotating the pan halfway through, until eggs are set, 15-18 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool for 1 minute. Use a silicone spatula to wedge each egg muffin out of its cup.
To serve, divide egg muffins between plates and enjoy!
